# Interface Kit

* **Status:** alpha ([what this means](status-vocabulary.md#alpha))
* **Language:** Rust + Dart
* **Kind:** cross-platform
* **Has real code today:** Yes
* **Source:** not public yet

## What it owns

Interface Kit provides shared composed UI/interaction patterns for household-computing surfaces (service tiles, install/status flows, navigation shells, pairing/onboarding chrome): not raw design tokens and not a full app.

*The registry entry for this Kit is still a short summary, so this card is brief.*

It is made up of: Interface Kit (module `patterns`), [Mold Kit](mold-kit.md) (module `mold`).
